overview.en:
Query Helicone requests and sessions to investigate errors, latency and model usage with the official MCP server.

Investigate model applications through the available traces, sessions, or evaluation records. Keep the model, dataset, and experiment context explicit when comparing behavior.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
通过 Helicone 官方 MCP 查询请求和会话，排查错误、延迟及模型用量。

通过可用追踪、会话或评测记录调查模型应用。比较行为时明确模型、数据集和实验背景。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。

starterPrompts.en: Investigate this model application's errors or latency using the available traces.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 使用可用追踪调查这个模型应用的错误或延迟。

starterPrompts.en: Compare these runs or sessions and summarize the differences.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 比较这些运行或会话，汇总差异。

starterPrompts.en: Prepare an evaluation review from the available records and identify missing evidence.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 根据可用记录准备评测复盘，并指出缺少的证据。

descriptions.en: Use Helicone in Ghast. Query Helicone requests and sessions to investigate errors, latency and model usage with the official MCP server. 通过 Helicone 官方 MCP 查询请求和会话，排查错误、延迟及模型用量。
